name: ACME Solar Holdings Limited
summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited, a solar independent power producing company, engages in developing, building, owning, operating, and maintaining utility scale grid connected solar power projects in India. The company owns and operates solar energy projects with installed capacity of 2540 MW; and develops and constructs solar energy projects with capacity of 3780 MW. It is also involved in the wind power and hybrid power generation business. In addition, the company provides engineering, procurement, and construction services, as well as operation and maintenance services. It serves central and state government-backed entities. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Gurugram, India. ACME Solar Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of ACME Cleantech Solutions Limited.
